note: Commands capture.py may run on the DGX Spark. A command passes only if every pipeline segment's first token belongs to a family below (or is a listed filter after a pipe), no deny pattern matches, and every redirection target is /dev/null or inside the capture --out directory. See rules/allowlist.md.

families.name: ollama
families.why: the runtime most viewers type; pull downloads weights, run measures, ps shows placement

families.name: llama-server
families.why: llama.cpp HTTP server for OpenAI-compatible benchmarks

families.name: vllm
families.why: vLLM serving and its bench command

families.name: python-benchmarks
families.why: only the benchmark scripts shipped in this skill; paths are repo-relative, run capture.py from the repo root

families.name: docker-run
families.why: NVIDIA NGC containers, the vLLM image and the Ollama image; nothing else

families.name: curl-local
families.why: hit a local inference endpoint; remote URLs are refused, downloads to disk are refused

families.name: lscpu
families.why: CPU facts for the on-screen spec card

deny.name: sudo
deny.why: nothing in a capture needs root

deny.name: rm
deny.why: captures never delete; clean up by hand

deny.name: ssh
deny.why: no remote hosts from a capture

deny.name: backticks
deny.why: command substitution hides the real command

deny.name: command-substitution
deny.why: command substitution hides the real command

deny.name: eval-exec
deny.why: process and system control are not captures

deny.name: chmod-chown
deny.why: installs and permission changes belong to build/install.sh
